_note: Per-YMMT maintenance schedules sourced from manufacturer owner's manuals. Each entry covers the FULL service schedule from new through high mileage. Intervals are anchored to the owner's manual; severe-service intervals follow the manual's severe-service definition (towing, frequent short trips, dusty conditions, sustained high temps).

_source_provenance.manufacturer_manual: Primary source — owner's manual PDF (cited per entry)
_source_provenance.owner_forum: Used only for cross-validation, NOT primary source
_source_provenance.ai_estimated: Last-resort fallback when manual not accessible; entries flagged 'verified: false'

source.primary: 2019 Chevrolet Camaro Owner's Manual + High-Performance Owner's Manual Supplement

engine_oil.interval: Per Engine Oil Life Monitor (typically 5,000-7,500 mi normal duty, 3,000-5,000 mi severe duty)
engine_oil.capacity: 10.0 qt with filter (LT4 dry sump system holds significantly more than standard V8s — verify dipstick after refill)
engine_oil.severe_service_note: Track use, towing, and sustained high-rpm operation: change every 3,000 mi or 6 months

supercharger_oil.fluid: Eaton TVS-specific lubricant (GM PN 89058050 or equivalent)
supercharger_oil.note: Self-contained reservoir at front of supercharger snout. Inspect for leaks at every oil change.

intercooler_coolant.interval: Inspect annually; top off as needed
intercooler_coolant.fluid: Distilled water + GM ICE coolant (dedicated low-temperature intercooler loop, separate from engine cooling)
intercooler_coolant.capacity: ~2 qt (small reservoir near front of engine bay)
intercooler_coolant.note: ZL1 intercooler is water-to-air — has its own pump and reservoir. Do NOT confuse with engine coolant reservoir.

engine_coolant.interval_first: 5 years or 150,000 mi (whichever first) — initial fill from factory
engine_coolant.fluid: Dex-Cool (orange, extended life) — do NOT mix with green/yellow coolant types

transmission_fluid_auto.interval: 97,500 mi (normal duty) — GM technically lists this as 'fill for life'
transmission_fluid_auto.interval_severe: 45,000 mi (track use, sustained hard driving, towing)
transmission_fluid_auto.fluid: Mobil 1 Synthetic LV ATF HP (also branded as Dexron HP)
transmission_fluid_auto.capacity: 5.5 qt drain-and-fill (10L80 — full capacity ~11.7 qt requires pan drop)
transmission_fluid_auto.note: Independent shops and ZF/GM technicians recommend earlier service than 'fill for life' — community consensus is 60,000-100,000 mi maximum for longevity.

transmission_fluid_manual.fluid: GM Synchromesh MTF (PN 88861800 US / 88861801 CAN) — Dexron III alternative if MTF unavailable
transmission_fluid_manual.note: Tremec TR-6060 is officially 'fill for life' per Tremec but most enthusiasts change at 45k for shift quality.

rear_differential.fluid: 75W-90 GL-5 Synthetic + GM Limited-Slip Additive (PN 88900330) — required for limited-slip differential
rear_differential.note: ZL1 1LE uses Multimatic DSSV dampers (different from MRC base ZL1) but rear diff fluid spec is identical.

brake_fluid.interval_severe: 6 months or per track session (any track day driver MUST change brake fluid frequently — DSSV/PFC race brakes generate enough heat to boil street fluid)
brake_fluid.fluid: DOT 4 (factory) — DOT 5.1 recommended upgrade for track use (NOT DOT 5 silicone — incompatible)
brake_fluid.note: ZL1 1LE has Brembo 6-piston front / 4-piston rear with track-spec rotors. Brake fluid hygroscopic — water absorption causes vapor lock under heavy braking.

spark_plugs.interval: 97,500 mi or per Spark Plug Life Monitor (later models)
spark_plugs.note: LT4 has 8 spark plugs. Access requires removing ignition coil packs. Do NOT apply anti-seize to iridium plugs (factory coating handles this).

air_filter.interval: Inspect every oil change; replace per inspection (typically 30,000-45,000 mi normal duty)
air_filter.interval_severe: Replace every 15,000-22,500 mi (dusty conditions, track use)
air_filter.note: ZL1 has high-flow air box. Check for debris ingestion after track use.

cabin_filter.interval: 22,500 mi or per HVAC airflow degradation

tire_rotation.interval_zl1_1le: NOT APPLICABLE — ZL1 1LE has staggered fitment (305/30R19 front, 325/30R19 rear) so front-to-rear rotation is NOT possible. Only same-axle side-to-side rotation if tires are non-directional.
tire_rotation.tire_spec_zl1_1le: Goodyear Eagle F1 Supercar 3R (track-spec, R-compound — different wear profile than standard ZL1's PS4S)

battery.note: ZL1 has electrical loads from sound system, displays, and 12V accessories. Group 48 AGM recommended for replacement.

owner_alerts: 10qt oil capacity — easy to under-fill if you assume typical V8 (6-8qt)
Dex-Cool ONLY — orange coolant; never mix with green/yellow
ZL1 1LE has DSSV dampers (not MRC) — no separate magnetic fluid to service
ZL1 1LE staggered tires (305 front / 325 rear) — standard rotation NOT possible
Dexos1 Gen 2+ certified oil required — avoid generic 5W-30
Track day prep: change brake fluid + check supercharger oil + verify diff additive
